release.notes: DEV TEST ONLY — Build 15.10.9: Smart Melody Detection v2. AUTO reads MIDI guide/vocal track names and lyric-aligned note timing without favoring Channel 4, declines uncertain guesses, and avoids percussion auto-selection. Per-song manual CH 1-16 override via Controls > Melody Channel or long-press MELODY; resets old channel mix on switch. Retains Build 15.10.8 rotation-safe I UNDERSTAND screen, Stable 15.10.7 interlude lyric look-ahead, scoring and remote/queue behavior. No change to lyric timing or MIDI tempo. Older experimental KISC pack reader excluded. Real-device QA needed. Stable/Beta untouched.
